positive_snippets: Great service and excellent arrangements for our retirement party at Rajwanshi Banquet. Everything was well organized and the staff was very supportive. Special thanks to **Gagan Shukla and his team** for their efforts in making the event smooth and memorable. Highly recommended!

A budget hotel and event venue in Sector 8, Gurugram, known for spacious banquet halls and basic rooms. Some guests praise its ambience for functions and helpful staff, while others report inconsistent service, cleanliness issues, and parking challenges. Overall, decent for small events or short stays if expectations match pricing.

Good Affordable Hotel on Old Rly Road near DSD college, Gurgaon. Newly Renovated rooms and Conference Hall , Can accommodate 200 people. Good tasty food. Attended Get Together meeting of Syndictebank Retirees on 27.4.2025 where 110 persons attended. It is in old Gurgaon.
negative_snippets: This hotel is absolutely terrible. Forget hot water — there isn’t even basic water in the bathroom. You can’t find anyone at the reception, and even if someone shows up by chance, they’ll just keep saying ‘5 minutes, 5 minutes’ and never solve your problem. They take full payment but provide zero service. I definitely do not recommend this place.
